Needle drop tracks and soundtrack songs from GTA 6 are expected to appear in official music charts

Grand Theft Auto 6 has been swerving into online feeds and cultural conversations since its record-breaking launch last week.

But one area where the game is really making a dent is the world of music.

Flower In A Hurricane, the single from the game's official soundtrack album by Justice featuring Tame Impala, SZA and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard, is tipped to climb the UK's official top ten later.

Go Easy, a new track from Dua Lipa specially recorded by the singer for the game, is also expected to perform well.

Run Away With Me, a 2015 song by Call Me Maybe singer Carly Rae Jepsen used during a "needle drop" moment in the game's first chapter, has also seen a huge spike in listeners.

Video game music has topped the UK chart before, when Robbie Williams' It's Only Us, recorded for the FIFA 2000 soundtrack, got to number one.

While Christmas favourites are expected to dominate the charts more widely this week, industry experts have been telling BBC Newsbeat the performance of GTA 6's music is unusual.

Music plays a key role in Grand Theft Auto 6, both inside and outside its storylines

There are three elements of GTA 6's soundtrack, including an official, double-sided album containing tracks recorded for the game, and an original score composed by electronic duo Justice, due to be fully released in December.

The game also features hundreds of licensed tracks on its in-game radio stations.

Flower In A Hurricane was released as a single in October, giving it time to appear on playlists in the lead-up to the game's debut.

But Mat Ombler, head of partnerships at video game music label Laced Records, says GTA 6's impact on the charts is still impressive.

He says video game soundtracks entering the album charts "isn't unheard of" but "it's incredibly rare to see multiple tracks hitting the singles charts".

He likens the spike in streams of Jepsen's track to the boost Kate Bush's Running Up That Hill got from its inclusion in Netflix hit Stranger Things.

"Both tracks are part of a huge cultural moment, but I'd argue that GTA's usage of Run Away With Me is more impactful... where the music responds according to what you're doing during a key story mission," he says.

Ombler thinks the chart impact of GTA 6 highlights "the growing importance and cultural impact of video game soundtracks as a whole".

"Over 40 million people will spend the coming weeks and months listening to more than 800 tracks featured in the in-game radio stations, possibly hundreds of times," he says.

"They'll discover new music in genres they might never have engaged with otherwise, and this music will stick with them for the rest of their lives."

Electronic duo Fcukers appear on the official GTA 6 soundtrack

Only One by New York band Fcukers appears on the official GTA 6 soundtrack and has already had more than one million streams on Spotify.

The group's singer Shanny Wise tells Newsbeat: "It was actually one of the songs we recorded when we were making our album, but it didn't end up making the album."

"We felt like the vibe of it maybe was too much of an outlier," adds bassist Jackson Walker Lewis.

"But when the GTA thing came around... I felt like it perfectly fit."

Lewis says the band didn't know they'd made the official soundtrack album until the tracklist leaked in the days leading up to the game's release.

"The one thing I'll say is, Rockstar operates very fluidly behind the scenes," says Lewis.

"They can change their mind last-minute. I think that's what makes them so good at what they do is because they have flexibility."

The electronic duo agree it was "beyond an honour" to appear alongside huge names such as pop star Dua Lipa and rapper Travis Scott.

"I mean, it's crazy and really... it blows me away," says Wise.

But, Lewis says, it's not the only thing making their big moment special.

"I think it's been a really long time since kind of globally we've had a monoculture moment that we can all share in, you know, in a positive way, in a joyful way," he says.

"Everyone across the globe is, for the most part, enjoying this game, and I just think it's a special thing to be a part of."

Carly Rae Jepsen's song Run Away With Me has seen a surge in interest thanks to the game

Steven Ellison, better known as Flying Lotus, points out the GTA series was already an established cultural phenomenon.

Millions of players heard the US producer, DJ, film-maker and rapper hosting FlyLo, one of GTA 5's in-game radio stations.

He also curated its tracklist - a job he confesses was made easier by the series' profile.

"People just wanted to have any involvement at all," he says.

"It was like: 'Who do we want? Who don't we want?' It was incredible."

He says the role gave him an opportunity to "shine a light on musicians from LA", his hometown, and the inspiration for the game's fictional location Los Santos.

It also influenced his own musical taste, he says.

"I remember when I played GTA: Vice City and it was the first time I actually listened to Africa by Toto.

"I was like: 'Man this song is awesome'. I didn't really know it before."

That curated experience, according to Ellison, is a big part of the appeal, and why the game can generate surprise hits out of neglected songs.

"It's so hard to get an experience like that nowadays with the way we listen to music and find music," he says.

"So this is kind of like that experience from back in the day where you're actually being put on to something by hanging out with people and then someone plays a track.

"It's that genuine connection that I think is possible with this."

Additional reporting by BBC Newsbeat reporters Jordan Kenny and Naomi Clarke.

The self-styled pastor was arrested in 2023 after the discovery of more than 400 bodies in shallow graves

A court in Kenya has convicted the leader of a doomsday Christian cult of the manslaughter of 123 of his followers.

Paul Mackenzie was found guilty in Mombasa of ordering his followers, all adults, to fast to death in Shakahola forest near the coast between January 2021 and September 2023.

Earlier this month Mackenzie was jailed for 200 years for murdering 191 people, all but one of them children, in the same mass killing.

Mackenzie had pleaded not guilty to manslaughter and one of his lawyers said he would appeal against the conviction after sentencing, Reuters news agency reports.

The court also convicted 29 others including Mackenzie's wife, Rhoda Mumbua Maweu, of their part in the manslaughter.

Sixty defendants were acquitted. The Director of Public Prosecutions indicated that an appeal would be launched against their acquittal.

The self-styled pastor was arrested in 2023 after the discovery of more than 400 bodies in shallow graves.

The court found Mackenzie had "systematically persuaded his followers to fast until they died", Kenya's Office of The Director of Public Prosecutions said in a statement on Friday's verdict, which it described as "the final conviction" in the Shakahola cases against him.

"Children were to go first, then women and then men, with Mackenzie himself meant to die last," the office said.

The prosecution argued that Mackenzie and his accomplices had acted together as part of a suicide pact to fast to death in order to "meet Jesus".

Witnesses testified that he had preached that education, medicine and ornaments were sinful.

Those who opposed his teachings were beaten to death, according to the verdict in his trial for the murder of 191 people.

The defendants claimed that the victims had fasted out of their own free will.

The Shakahola deaths have shone a spotlight on the lack of oversight of rogue religious activities and how they could have carried on for so long.

The gravity of the case prompted President William Ruto to set up a commission of inquiry, although this was later declared unconstitutional.

MN202611_1w2wtluor0g.t:
Savio has not scored for Spurs since netting on his debut in August

Tottenham winger Savio will miss the club's Christmas fixtures with injury and could be out for up to 80 days, manager Roberto de Zerbi has confirmed.

Savio joined Spurs from Manchester City for £75m this summer, but has played in just five of their 11 Premier League matches this season.

The 22-year-old came on as a substitute in the 64th minute of Tottenham 's 2-0 win over Ipswich on Saturday, but was forced off with two minutes remaining with a hamstring injury.

It was the attacker's first game back in six weeks after returning from a muscle problem which led to him missing the four previous league matches.

Asked if Savio, previously known as Savinho, would miss the Christmas schedule, De Zerbi said: "Yes, I think so unfortunately.

"It is a tough situation to accept. He is a good guy. He is suffering for this new injury but it is part of football."

"If you see the other European clubs, all of them, they are suffering many, many injuries."

Savio is still searching for his first league goal or assist for Tottenham , although he did score and assist a goal on his debut in August in a 5-1 win over Charlton in the Carabao Cup.

"Now, he needs time and hard work with the medical staff," De Zerbi added.

"Then in 50, 60 or 80 days - I don't know when he comes back - he'll be crucial for us for the last step of the season."

Tottenham are 10th in the league and have won four of their past five matches after a poor start to the season.

They travel to 18th-placed Sunderland on Sunday (14:05 GMT).

The French president said he was proud to have led efforts to ban Brazilian meat products

Brazil says it "regrets" a statement by French President Emmanuel Macron who called Brazilian meat "doped".

France's leader made the comment while meeting representatives of farming unions on Wednesday, during which he celebrated EU restrictions on imports of Brazilian meat and poultry which took effect in September.

In its statement, the Brazilian government said Macron's statements "spread misinformation and contradict the widely available technical and scientific evidence on animal protein production in Brazil".

Macron's comments come as part of a trade row between the EU and Mercosur - the South American trade bloc. The EU banned Brazilian meat and poultry owing to the use of antimicrobials in farming.

In its defence, Brazil said it had supplied animal protein to the EU for decades and that it exported meat to 177 markets. It added the country had a rigorous sanitary control system, corroborated by a recent European audit, and observed stringent environmental requirements.

Macron, in his opening remarks in the meeting with the agricultural sector representatives at Élysée Palace, said he was "proud of the fight we led" against Mercosur.

"And the 'doped' meat, if I may put it that way, or rather meat from Mercosur countries, especially Brazil, that was arriving in our ports and therefore entering our markets without complying with our rules, was ultimately banned," he said.

Brazil said it was concerned about the "clearly political nature" of recent EU restrictions, and urged France to reconsider its position "in light of scientific evidence".

Affirming its partnership with France was important, the country emphasised that "in the face of protectionist pressures, the best interests of the bilateral relationship must prevail, always guided by mutual respect and reciprocity".

Brazil is a massive exporter of meat, especially beef - some $1.84bn (£1.4bn) of which went to EU markets alone in 2025, according to Brazil's agricultural ministry.

MN202611_1osvnvtd93b.t:
Senateri Emmanuel Havugimana, umubyeyi, inararibonye, umwarimu n'umunyamateka w'Umunyarwanda, yasobanuye uburyo yise izina umukobwa we, w'imfura mu rubyaro rwe, abikurike ku izina nyirarume yise umuhungu we mu myaka isaga mirongo itandatu ishize.

Yifuriza isabukuru y'amavuko umukobwa we Nindemana Nicole ku wa 10 Ugushyingo, Senateri Havugimana yasobanuye ko byaturutse mu muhango wo kwandikisha mu irangamimerere umwana witwa Nindemana Michel.

Yagize ati "Nindemana ni izina rifite amateka mu muryango wanjye! Mu Ugushyingo 1963, marume Izayasi Gakwandi, yabyaye umwana w'umuhungu, nuko ku munsi wo kuva ku kiriri izuba rirenze nka 18h00, tujya kurya ubunnyano twita umwana izina. Jyewe umenya naramwise Rusagara, kubera umwana twari duturanye nakundaga witwaga Rusagara. Nuko turataha tutamenye izina se amuhaye. Hashize icyumweru ajya kumwandikisha kuri Komini Rukondo. Ati mwise Nindemana Michel. Ngo Bourgmestre witwaga Munyarubindo Gregoire aryumvise, aratangara cyane, aratekerezaaaa....ati :"Ni nde mana koko? Ni nde mana koko? Ni nde mana koko?" ngo aguma abisubiramo yimyoza! Izina nanjye numva ndarikunze! Mbyaye umwana nanjye mwita Nindemana Nicole. Nindemana Michel bamwe mu banyabutare bashobora kuba bari bamuzi. Yari mukuru wa Fidele Ndayisaba. Iwabo bari batuye mu Matyazo. Michel Nindemana bamwishe muri Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi muri 1994.

Hagati aho, Nindemana Nicole yavutse mu Gushyingo 1988.

Senateri Havugimana, umubyeyi ukunda umuryango, waba uwe bwite, bene wabo ba hafi na kure, ndetse n'umuryango nyarwanda muri rusange, yifurije umukobwa we isabukuru y'amavuko ku wa 10 Ugushyingo, abishyira ku rubuga rwa Facebook akoresha cyane, agira ati "Uyu mukobwa wanjye Nindemana Nicole nawe uyu munsi, tariki 10/11 muri 1988 yaravutse, nanjye mba mbaye Papa ubwa mbere!! Happy Birthday my eldest daughter Maitre Nindemana Nicole."

Nindemana Nicole ni umunyamategeko - avoka, akaba n'Umukristu. Nk'uko abikomora kuri se, na we ni umubyeyi ukunda abantu n'umuryango, kandi akabagira inama yo kwicisha bugufi, no kudakangwa n'ibihe byiza bari kunyuramo, kuko n'ibihe bibi bishobora kubageraho.

Ku rubuga rwe rwa X akoresha, hari aho agira ati "Ntuzigere utakaza uwo uri we. Umwanya w’icyubahiro cyangwa inshingano ufite uyu munsi bishobora kukuvaho mu kanya nk’ako guhumbya. Abantu benshi baguhamagara, bagusaba kubonana nawe aha n’aha kubera ko uri umuntu ukenewe cyane, ariko umunsi umwe ibyo byose bishobora guhagarara, ukaba utacyumva n’uwuguhamagara."

Ahandi ati "Birababaje kubona ukuntu twe abantu tutifuza kugira aho duhurira n'abantu bacitse intege, nyamara ari bwo baba bakeneye ubufasha n'ubwitange bwacu kurusha ikindi gihe cyose.

Akenshi duhitamo kugendana n'abantu bamerewe neza, bafite ubuzima butekanye, biyubashye, ibintu bimeze neza. Ariko muri icyo gihe ni bwo abantu bacitse intege bamenya abari inshuti nyazo, bakamenya ababakunda by'ukuri n'abazabagumaho mu bihe bikomeye.

Ntiwihutire guca ukubiri n'umuntu wacitse intege. Ashobora kuba atagukeneye igihe ibintu byose biri kugendekera neza, ahubwo akaba agukeneye cyane mu gihe ubuzima bwamukomeranye."

Hagati aho, Senateri Havugimana agomba kuba yarahiriwe n'Ukwezi k'Ugushyingo.

Mu yindi nyandiko yifurije isabukuru y'amavuko undi mwana we agira ati "Isabukuru nziza y’amavuko ku mukobwa wanjye Michèle Iradukunda!

Ndibuka ko hari ku Cyumweru, tariki ya 5 Ugushyingo 1989, i Bukeye mu Burundi, aho nari naratangiye kwigisha kuva mu mwaka wa 1984.

Ahagana saa tanu za mu gitondo (11h00), umuntu yinjiye mu Kiliziya maze anyongorera mu gutwi ambwira ko banshaka ku Kigo Nderabuzima cy’aho hafi. Uwo mwana yavutse nyuma y’isaha imwe ngeze ku Kigo Nderabuzima.

Nyagasani akomeze kukurinda no kuguha kubaho indi myaka myinshi mwana wanjye."

MN202611_10y9tamlr58.t:
Abakunzi b’imyidagaduro mu Rwanda bategerejwe n’impera z’icyumweru zirimo ibitaramo bitandukanye, bizahuza abahanzi Nyarwanda n’abakunzi babo haba mu gihugu no mu mahanga. NIWE HEALING CONCERT 2

Mu bitaramo biteganyijwe mu Mujyi wa Kigali, harimo igitaramo cya Richard Nick Ngendahayo cyiswe ‘Niwe Healing Concert’ kigiye kuba ku nshuro ya kabiri, nyuma y’icyo yakoreye muri BK Arena ku wa 29 Ugushyingo 2025, ubwo yari amaze imyaka 17 adataramira mu Rwanda.

Iki gitaramo kizahuza abakunzi b'umuziki wo kuramya no guhimbaza, kizaba kuri uyu wa Gatandatu, tariki ya 28 Ugushyingo muri BK Arena.

Mu bazafatanya na Richard Nick Ngendahayo muri iki gitaramo harimo Pastor Julienne K. Kabanda uzigisha Ijambo ry'Imana ndetse akaba azanaririmba. Hazaba kandi ibindi bikorwa bizafasha abazacyitabira kubona umwanya wo gusenga no gukomeza gukura mu buryo bw'umwuka.

Richard Nick Ngendahayo ari mu bahanzi bamaze igihe kinini bafite izina rikomeye mu muziki wo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana mu Rwanda, binyuze mu ndirimbo zakunzwe zirimo ‘Si Umuhemu’, ‘Intwari batinya’, ‘Ni we’, ‘Urera’, ‘Yambaye icyubahiro’, ‘Mbwira ibyo ushaka’, ‘Wemere ngushime’ na ‘Ibuka’.

Abakunzi b’imyidagaduro mu barararitswe mu gitaramo ‘Cabaret Kigali 2’, gitegurwa na Ally Soudy, kizaba ku wa 28 Ugushyingo 2026, kikabera muri Kigali Universe, kikazahuza ibikorwa bitandukanye by’imyidagaduro birimo umuziki wa ‘Live’, imbyino, urwenya, ibiganiro n’ubundi buhanzi.

‘Cabaret Kigali’ ni izina rishya ryahawe igitaramo cyari gisanzwe kizwi nka ‘Ally Soudy & Friends Live Show’, cyaherukaga kuba mu 2023 muri Camp Kigali.

Umuhanzi w’umunyabigwi mu muziki gakondo, Jules Sentore, n’Itorero Inyamibwa bamenyekanye mu kubyina no gusigasira umuco Nyarwanda, bari mu bazataramira abazitabira iki gitaramo cya Ally Soudy.

I BWERANGANZO, CHORALE CHRISTUS REGNAT IGIYE KWIZIHIZA IMYAKA 20

Chorale Christus Regnat, imwe muri Chorale zikunzwe muri Kiliziya Gatolika mu Rwanda, igiye kwizihiza imyaka 20 imaze mu ivugabutumwa binyuze mu muziki, ibinyujije mu gitaramo cyiswe ‘i Bweranganzo Concert’, kizaba ku nshuro ya gatatu.

Iki gitaramo giteganyijwe ku cyumweru tariki 29 Ugushyingo 2026, muri Sainte Famille Hotel kikazaba umwanya wihariye wo gushimira Imana ku rugendo rw'imyaka 20, aho abaririmbyi b'iyi korali n'abakunzi bayo bazahurira mu ndirimbo zo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana.

Chorale Christus Regnat yatangiye mu 2006, ivukira kuri Centre Christus i Remera. Yashinzwe n'abakirisitu bari bafite icyifuzo cyo kujya baririmbira Imana mu buryo bunogeye amatwi mu bitambo bya Misa no mu yindi mihango ya Kiliziya.

Izina Christus Regnat rikomoka mu rurimi rw'Ikilatini risobanura ngo ‘Kristu Uganje’. Ni izina rijyanye n'intego y'iyi korali yo gukoresha impano yo kuririmba mu kwamamaza ubutumwa bwiza no gufasha abantu kurushaho kwegera Imana.

Mu myaka 20 imaze, iyi korali yagiye ikura haba mu mubare w'abayigize ndetse no mu bikorwa by'ivugabutumwa. Mu 2022, ubwo yizihizaga imyaka 16, yari imaze kugira abaririmbyi bagera ku 100, b'ingeri zitandukanye, kandi yari imaze gushyira hanze Album eshanu z'indirimbo z'amajwi, iya gatandatu iri hafi gusohoka icyo gihe.

BWIZA AZAMURIKIRA ALBUM 'HOME' MURI ZAMBIA

Iyi weekend izasiga, umuhanzikazi w’Umunyarwandakazi Bwiza amurikiye abakunzi be bo muri Zambia album ye ya gatatu yise "Home", mu gitaramo kizaba kuri uyu wa Gatandatu, tariki ya 28 Ugushyingo 2026.

Muri iki gitaramo, Bwiza azaba aherekejwe n’abandi bahanzi barimo Bruce Melodie wahagurutse I Kigali ku wa Kane mu rwego rwo kujya kumushyigikira. Hazaba kandi hari Roberto wamamaye mu ndirimbo "Amarula" ndetse n’itsinda rya Chanda Na Kay bose bo muri Zambia.

Iki gitaramo kizabera ahitwa Scream Disco, muri KK Mall i Lusaka, kikazaba ari amahirwe kuri Bwiza yo kugeza ku bakunzi be bo muri Zambia indirimbo zigize album Home, anamenyekanisha ibikorwa bye bya muzika ku rundi rwego.

Album Home ni umushinga we wa gatatu, akaba yamaze no gutangaza ko yamaze gusohoka ku mbuga zose zicururizwaho umuziki hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga. Indirimbo "Murugo" ni yo yahisemo nk’intangiriro yo kumenyekanisha iyi album.

Muri iyi weekend, umuhanzi King James nawe azaba yizihiriza mu Mujyi wa Phoenix, muri Leta ya Arizona muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, imyaka 20 amaze mu muziki, mu gitaramo cyiswe "20 Years of King James".

Iki gitaramo giteganyijwe kuri uyu wa Gatandatu, tariki ya 28 Ugushyingo 2026, muri Celebrity Theatre, aho uyu muhanzi azasusurutsa abakunzi be batuye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Ni igitaramo kandi amatike yacyo yose yamaze gushira ku isoko.

King James yinjiye mu muziki mu 2006, amenyekana cyane binyuze mu ndirimbo z’urukundo zakunzwe n’abatari bake, zirimo Naratomboye, Nta Mahitamo, Ndakwizera, Yaciye Ibintu na Naramukundaga, n’izindi.

Mu rwego rwo kwizihiza iyi myaka 20, uyu muhanzi yari yabanje gukorera ibitaramo bibiri muri BK Arena i Kigali, ku wa 1 n’uwa 2 Kanama 2026, mbere yo gukomereza urugendo rwe rw'ibitaramo mu Burayi ndetse na Amerika.

ELEMENT ELEÉEH AZABA ARI MU MUJYI WA LOUISVILLE

Mugisha Fred Robinson, umuhanzi akaba n’umuhanga mu gutunganya imiziki umaze kwamamara nka Element EleéeH, azaba ataramira abakunzi be mu Mujyi wa Louisville, muri Leta ya Kentucky muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, mu gitaramo giteganyijwe kuri uyu wa Gatanu, tariki ya 27 Ugushyingo 2026.

Iki gitaramo kiri mu rugendo rw’ibitaramo uyu muhanzi ari gukorera muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, aho yatangiye ku wa 21 Ugushyingo 2026 mu Mujyi wa Dayton, muri Leta ya Ohio.

Muri iki gitaramo cyo i Louisville, Element EleéeH azasusurutsa abakunzi be mu ndirimbo zitandukanye zamamaye, zirimo Fou de toi, Kashe, Tombé, Milele, Maaso na My Dear.

By'umwihariko, iki gitaramo kizaba nyuma y’aho uyu muhanzi ashyiriye hanze amashusho y’indirimbo My Dear, bikaba ari amahirwe yo kuyimenyekanisha no kongera kuyiririmbira abakunzi be bari muri Amerika.

Element EleéeH ni umwe mu bahanzi nyarwanda bakora umuziki ndetse bakanawutunganya, akaba akomeje kwagura ibikorwa bye binyuze mu bitaramo no kugeza ibihangano bye ku bakunzi b’umuziki baba hanze y’u Rwanda.

Ubushakashatsi bw’Umuryango urwanya ruswa, akarengane ukanaharanira iyimikazwa ry’imiyoborere myiza mu Rwanda (Transparency International Rwanda/TI-Rwanda) bugaragaza ko abanyeshuri bamwe bahatirwa guhitamo hagati yo kwemera gusambanywa kugira ngo batsinde amasomo cyangwa guhomba amahirwe yo gukomeza amasomo yabo.

Ruswa ishingiye ku gitsina ni ikibazo gikomeje kugaragara mu mashuri makuru na za kaminuza mu Rwanda, aho bamwe mu bafite inshingano zo kwigisha no gusuzuma abanyeshuri bakekwaho gukoresha ububasha bafite mu gutanga amanota kugira ngo basabe abanyeshuri kubaha ibyo bakeneye bishingiye ku gitsina.

Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe TIR, bugaragaza ko amashuri makuru ari mu nzego zugarijwe n’iki kibazo, kikabangamira uburenganzira bw’abanyeshuri ku burezi no kubona amanota ashingiye ku bumenyi bafite.

Raporo yiswe ‘An Impossible Choice: Power Plays and Sexual Corruption in Rwanda’s Higher Education Institutions’ igaragaza ko amashuri makuru na za Kaminuza, byaje ku mwanya wa kabiri mu nzego zagaragayemo ruswa ishingiye ku gitsina, aho 42.6% by'ababajijwe bagaragaje ko iki kibazo gihari.

Uko ruswa ishingiye ku gitsina ikorwa Ubu bushakashatsi bugaragaza ko bamwe mu barimu bakoresha ububasha bafite mu kugena amanota no kwemerera abanyeshuri gukora ibizamini, bakabasaba kubaha serivisi zishingiye ku gitsina kugira ngo babone amanota cyangwa badahagarikirwa amasomo.

Ubuhamya bwatanzwe na bamwe mu banyeshuri bugaragaza ko hari abarimu batsindisha abanyeshuri b’abakobwa nkana bakabemerera kuzabaha amanota ari uko bamaze kuryamana.

Umwe muri bo ati “Hari inshuti yanjye byabayeho cyane, binamuviramo gutwara inda, kandi byose byaratewe n’umwarimu watwigishaga icyo gihe. Twajyaga gukora ikizamini twese tugifite, yarakimuhaye.”

Mugenzi we ati “Hari mugenzi wanjye byabayeho, yari umuhanga twese tubizi, hanyuma amanota asohotse umunyeshuri asanga afite zero (0), kandi mu bigaragara imikoro yose yarayikoze. Ahamagara mwarimu aramubwira ati ko jyewe mbona nta manota mfite kandi narakoze ibintu byose, nta hantu nari nagiye, bimeze bite? Mwarimu amubwira ahantu bazahurira ngo babiganireho, aramubwira ati hano muri Kaminuza iyo uzanye ubujiji urasibira, kandi njye bwo ku gusibiza n’umwaka utaha nkazongera nka gusibiza.”

Uwo mwarimu yakomeje amubwira ko kugira ngo bikemuke ari uko baryamana kandi ko naramuka abyanze akarega mu nzego z’ubuyobozi, umwarimu afite uburenganzira bwo kwanga ku mukosora.

Yungamo ati “Aramubwira ati kugira ngo bikunde ni uko tubanza tukaryamana, hanyuma nanjye nkazaguha amanota, ndetse no mu yindi myaka yo hejuru aho tuzahurira nkajya nguha amanota ukimuka nta kibazo kibayeho. Umukobwa arabyanga hanyuma umwarimu arakomeza amuha zero.”

Undi ati “Jye umunararibonye mfite kuri ruswa y’igitsina mfite n’ibyo nzi byabaye ku nshuti yanjye ubwo twari turi muri Kaminuza, mu gihe cyo kwandika igitabo, yandika igice cya mbere n’icya kabiri, uko abiha umwarimu ntabikosore, akibaza icyabiteye, akamuhamagara, ntamwitabe. Aza kumwemerera ko bahura, bageze ahari amacumbi, amwereka ko igisubizo cy’uko ashaka ko akosorwa n’ubundi natemera ko baryamana ataha bitabaye.”

Undi watanze ubuhamya ni umunyeshuri wari mu imenyerezamwuga ubwo yari arimo kurangiza Kaminuza, hanyuma akaza kubwirwa n’umuyobozi w’ikigo wagombaga kumuha amanota ko yamukunze kandi ko natemera ko baryamana, atazigera amuha amanota.

Ati “Naragiye mbiganiriza mama, arangije arambwira ati genda iyo stage uyivemo, urumva n’amanota ntiyigeze ayampa, natahiye aho, stage ndayireka bisanba kujya kuyaka ahandi.”

Izi ngero n’zindi zigaragaza uburyo ubusumbane bw'ububasha hagati y'umwarimu n'umunyeshuri bushobora gutuma uburenganzira bw'abanyeshuri buhutazwa, cyane cyane iyo uwagombye kubarengera ari we ubashyiraho igitutu.

Ubwo kuri uyu wa 25 Ugushyingo 2026, hatangizwaga iminsi 16 yahariwe ibikorwa byo kurwanya ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina, Minisiteri y’Uburenganire n’Iterambere ry’Umuryango (MIGEPROF) yagaragaje ko hakiri imbogamizi zishingiye ku myumvire n’imigenzereze ishimangira ubusumbane hagati y’abagore n’abagabo, ipfobya ikanihanganira ihohotera n’imyumvire ituma abana batabona amakuru n’uburere bibafasha kwirinda.

Umuyobozi Nshingwabikorwa wa TIR, Apollinaire Mupiganyi, yagaragaje ko amashuri makuru na za kaminuza bikwiye kongera ubukangurambaga no gushyiraho uburyo bwizewe abanyeshuri n'abatangabuhamya bashobora kunyuramo batanga amakuru ku ihohoterwa na ruswa ishingiye ku gitsina.

Yagize ati: “Abanyeshuri bagomba kwizezwa ko ibirego byabo bizumvwa, bigafatwa nk'iby'ingenzi kandi bigakurikiranwa, aho kubihinyura, kubasuzugura cyangwa kubikoresha mu kubahima.”

Yavuze ko uburyo bwo gutanga amakuru bugomba kuba bworoshye kandi bwubahiriza ibanga ry'uyatanze, kugira ngo uwahuye n'ikibazo atongera guhura n'ibindi bimubangamira.

Hanagaragajwe ko abanyeshuri batagomba gushyirwa mu ihurizo ryo guhitamo hagati yo gukomeza amashuri yabo no kurengera agaciro kabo, asaba ibigo by'amashuri makuru gushyiraho uburyo bukomeye bwo kugenzura no gukumira ikoreshwa nabi ry'ububasha bw'abafite inshingano zo kwigisha.

Imibare y’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Ibarurishamibare igaragaza ko abangavu batewe inda hagati ya 2020/2025 bavuye kuri 5% bakagera ku 8%, mu gihe iya Minisiteri y’Ubuzima igaragaza ko abangavu bagera kuri 60 baterwa inda buri munsi.

Agendeye kuri iyo mibare, Minisitiri w’Uburinganire n’Iterambere ry’Umuryango Consolee Uwimana, yavuze ko inyuma yayo hari abangavu bahura n’ihungabana, abatereranwa, abahagarika amashuri n’abisanga mu nshingano zo kurera kandi na bo bari bagikeneye kurerwa.

Agira ati “Buri mwana usambanyijwe, ni ubuzima buhungabanyijwe, ni icyizere gikomerekejwe, ni inzozi n’ejo hazaza hashyizwe mu kaga. Abana n’abandi bahohotewe, tubatege amatwi, tubashishikarize gutanga amakuru ku nzego zibishinzwe, no kudaterwa ubwoba cyangwa gushukwa ngo bareke kuvuga ibyababayeho.”

Mu Rwanda, Itegeko Nº 54/2018 ryo ku wa 13 Kanama 2018 ryerekeye kurwanya ruswa rihana ruswa ishingiye ku gitsina, aho uhamijwe icyaha ashobora gukatirwa igifungo kiri hagati y'imyaka itanu n'icumi.

Nubwo hariho amategeko ayikumira, raporo ya Transparency International igaragaza ko gukurikirana no guhana abayikora bikiri imbogamizi, kuko ibirego by'iyi ruswa bitagaragara cyane mu byaha bikunze kurangira abaregwa bahanwe.

Mu busesenguzi bwe abinyujije ku rubuga rwe rwa X, yashyize ahagaragara kuri uyu wa 27 Ugushyingo 2026, Mwenda yavuze ko yaganiriye n’abantu bakomeye mu buyobozi bw’Ingabo za Uganda (UPDF) no muri Guverinoma y’icyo gihugu, bakamugaragariza ko bahangayikishijwe n’ibitero n’ihohoterwa bikomeje kwibasira abaturage bo mu Ntara za Ituri, Kivu ya Ruguru na Kivu y’Amajyepfo.

Yavuze ko ubuyobozi bwa Uganda bunahangayikishijwe n’ibitero bikomeje kugabwa n’umutwe wa ADF mu gace ka Isiro, aho umuyobozi wawo, Musa Baluku, bivugwa ko yahashinze ibirindiro bye. Mwenda yagaragaje ko UPDF ishobora kwagura ibikorwa bya gisirikare ikagera muri ako gace kugira ngo ifate Baluku, nk’uko Gen. Muhoozi Kainerugaba, Umugaba Mukuru w’Ingabo za Uganda, yari aherutse kubitangaza.

Mwenda yakomeje agira ati: "Kampala igenda irushaho guhangayikishwa n’ibirego by’ihohoterwa rikorerwa abaturage bo mu miryango y’Abahima n’Abatutsi mu Burasirazuba bwa RDC, bikozwe n’abasirikare ba FARDC n’imitwe bafatanyije."

Yasobanuye ko kuba Uganda ifitanye ubufatanye na Guverinoma ya RDC mu kurwanya ADF budakwiye gufatwa nk’aho Uganda ishyigikiye cyangwa igira uruhare mu byaha byaba bikorerwa abaturage n’inzego za Leta ya Congo cyangwa imitwe ifatanyije na zo.

UGANDA ISHOBORA KUGIRANA IMIKORANIRE NA FRN

Mwenda yavuze ko amakuru yahawe n’abantu avugana na bo agaragaza ko Kampala yatangiye kubona FRN nk’umutwe ugira uruhare mu kurinda abaturage bo mu Burasirazuba bwa RDC, bityo ikaba yifuza kugirana na wo imikoranire.

Yavuze ko uyu mutwe umaze gushyiraho ubuyobozi n’imikorere y’ubutegetsi mu bice bimwe na bimwe bya Kivu ya Ruguru n'iy’Amajyepfo, bityo Uganda ikaba ibona ko kugirana na wo ibiganiro byafasha mu kubaka imiyoborere ihamye muri ako Karere.

FRN ni umutwe mushya wa politiki n’igisirikare washinzwe mu Ukwakira 2026, uyobowe n’uwahoze ari Perezida wa Repubulika Iharanira Demukarasi ya Congo, Joseph Kabila, wasimbuye ihuriro rya AFC/M23.

UGANDA ISANGA IBIGANIRO BY'AMAHORO BYASHYIRWA KU RWEGO RW’AKARERE

Mwenda yavuze ko Uganda ibona ko inzira ishobora gufasha mu gukemura amakimbirane yo mu Burasirazuba bwa RDC ari ugukoresha inzego z’ubufatanye bw’akarere kugira ngo Guverinoma ya Kinshasa na FRN bigere ku meza y’ibiganiro.

Yavuze ko ibiganiro byabereye i Doha muri Qatar bitagihagije mu gukemura ibibazo biriho, bitewe n’impinduka zabaye mu mitwe ihanganye n’ubutegetsi bwa RDC, by’umwihariko ishingwa rya FRN, avuga ko uyu munsi ufite ubuyobozi bushya, abanyamuryango benshi n’uruhare rwa politiki rwagutse.

Yongeyeho ko ibiganiro byabereye i Washington muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika no muri Doha bitahaye umwanya uhagije ibibazo n’ibyifuzo by’andi matsinda y’abaturage bo mu Burasirazuba bwa RDC yibasiwe n’intambara.

Ku bwe, Mwenda abona ko gukemura ikibazo cy’umutekano muri RDC bisaba ibiganiro bigari ku rwego rw'Igihugu, byitabirwa n’impande n’imiryango itandukanye yibasiwe n’amakimbirane, aho kwibanda ku bibazo by’itsinda rimwe cyangwa abiri gusa.

Yavuze ko ibyo biganiro bikwiye kuyoborwa hifashishijwe inzego z’akarere zirimo Umuryango wa Afurika y’Iburasirazuba (EAC) n’Umuryango w’Iterambere ry’Ibihugu byo muri Afurika y’Amajyepfo (SADC).

Nubwo muri iki gihe iki kimenyetso gifatwa nk'ikiranga isi y'ikoranabuhanga, amateka yacyo atangirira mu binyejana byinshi bishize ndetse mbere y'uko mudasobwa na internet bibaho.

Nta gihamya yemejwe n'abashakashatsi bose igaragaza neza igihe n'aho ikimenyetso cya @ cyatangiriye. Icyakora, hari inkuru zitandukanye zivuga inkomoko yacyo.

Bivugwa ko iki kimenyetso gishobora kuba cyaraturutse ku banditsi bo mu gihe cy’amateka gihuza iherezo ry’Ingoma y’Abaroma n’intangiriro y’ibihe bishya by’iterambere ry’u Burayi (Middle Ages), bakoreshaga uburyo bwo kugabanya amagambo kugira ngo boroshye akazi ko kwandika no gukoporora inyandiko.

Bamwe mu bashakashatsi bavuga ko bashobora kuba baragabanyije ijambo ry'Ikilatini 'ad', risobanura 'kuri', 'ahagana' cyangwa 'mu cyerekezo cya'. Bavuga ko inyuguti 'a' n'igice cy'inyuguti 'd' byaje guhurizwa hamwe, bigatanga ishusho isa n'ikimenyetso cya @.

Ibindi bavuga hari uguhuza iki kimenyetso n'ijambo ry'Igifaransa 'à', na ryo risobanura 'kuri'. Hari kandi abahuza inkomoko yacyo n'ijambo ry'Ikilatini 'amphora', ryakoreshwaga mu kuvuga ibikoresho binini by'ibumba byabikwagamo divayi n'ibindi bicuruzwa.

IKIMENYETSO CYA @ MU BUCURUZI BWO HAMBERE

Imwe mu nyandiko za kera zizwiho kugaragaramo ikimenyetso cya @ yashyizweho itariki ya tariki ya 4 Gicurasi 1536. Iyo nyandiko yari ibaruwa y'umucuruzi w'Umutaliyani witwaga Francesco Lapi, wayandikiye i Seville muri Espagne ayohereza i Roma mu Butaliyani.

Muri iyo baruwa, yakoresheje ikimenyetso cya @ agaragaza igipimo cy'ibicuruzwa byari bipfunyitse mu bikoresho byitwaga Amphora, byakoreshwaga mu kubika no gupima divayi. Amphora ntiyari igikoresho cyo kubikamo divayi gusa, kuko n'ubunini bw'icyo gikoresho bwakoreshwaga nk'igipimo mu bucuruzi.

Ibi byatumye bamwe mu bashakashatsi bahuza ikimenyetso cya @ n'uburyo abacuruzi bo muri icyo gihe bagaragazaga ibipimo n'ubwinshi bw'ibicuruzwa.

Nyuma y'igihe, ikimenyetso cya @ cyakomeje gukoreshwa mu bucuruzi, cyane cyane mu kwerekana igiciro cy'igicuruzwa kuri buri gipimo cyangwa kuri buri gice cyacyo.

Urugero, iyo umucuruzi yandikaga ngo: 10 @ $2, byasobanuraga ko hari ibicuruzwa 10, buri kimwe gifite agaciro k'Amadolari abiri. Bityo, byose hamwe bikaba bifite agaciro k'Amadolari 20.

Ni muri ubwo buryo ikimenyetso cya @ cyaje kumenyekana nk'ikimenyetso cy'ubucuruzi, kizwi mu Cyongereza nka Commercial At.

Mu kinyejana cya 19, cyatangiye gushyirwa ku mashini zandikwagaho inyandiko (Typewriters), kuko abacuruzi n'abakora ibaruramari bari bamaze kukimenyera.

Mu 1885, ikimenyetso cya @ cyari kimaze kugaragara kuri zimwe mu mashini zandikirwagaho inyandiko zo mu bwoko bwa Underwood. Nyuma cyaje gukomeza kuba kimwe mu bimenyetso bisanzwe biboneka kuri za mashini zandika.

UKO NONEHO IKIMENYETSO CYA @ CYINJIYE MU IKORANABUHANGA

Nubwo ikimenyetso cya @ cyari kimaze igihe kinini gikoreshwa mu bucuruzi, nticyari kizwi cyane nk'uko bimeze muri iki gihe. Icyakora, ibintu byahindutse mu mwaka wa 1971, ubwo umuhanga mu bya mudasobwa w'Umunyamerika witwaga Ray Tomlinson yagihaga akazi gashya mu ikoranabuhanga.

Tomlinson yakoraga mu kigo cya Bolt Beranek and Newman (BBN), cyari gifite uruhare mu guteza imbere umuyoboro wa mudasobwa wa ARPANET, wafatwaga nk'intangiriro y'ikoranabuhanga ryaje guhinduka internet y'iki gihe.

Icyo gihe yari arimo gukora uburyo bwo kohereza ubutumwa hagati y'abakoresha mudasobwa zitandukanye, yari akeneye ikimenyetso cyatandukanya izina ry'umuntu wohereza cyangwa wakira ubutumwa n'izina rya mudasobwa cyangwa umuyoboro ubutumwa bugomba kunyuraho.

Amaze kureba ibimenyetso byari kuri mashini yakoreshaga, yahisemo @. Impamvu yagihisemo yasanze ari uko icyo kimenyetso kitakoreshwaga cyane mu mazina y'abakoresha mudasobwa kandi cyari gisanzwe gisobanura ijambo 'at', risobanura 'kuri' cyangwa 'ahantu runaka'.

Bityo, cyari kiboneye mu kwerekana ko umuntu afite aderesi kuri mudasobwa cyangwa umuyoboro runaka.

UKO @ YABAYE INGENZI MURI ADERESI ZA IMEYILI

Nyuma y'icyo cyemezo, hatangiye gukoreshwa uburyo bw'aderesi za imeri bugizwe n'izina ry'ukoresha, hagakurikiraho ikimenyetso cya @ n'izina ry'umuyoboro cyangwa seriveri akoresha.

Muri uru rugero: Janvier ni izina ry'ukoresha aderesi ya imeyili. @ ni ikimenyetso gitandukanya izina ry'ukoresha n'ikiranga serivisi cyangwa umuyoboro akoresha. gmail.com ni izina rya serivisi itanga iyo aderesi ya imeyili.

Ibi byatumye ubutumwa bushobora koherezwa ku muntu runaka hifashishijwe aderesi ye, nubwo yaba ari kure y'uwabwohereje.

Ubutumwa bwa mbere bwo muri ubu buryo bwa imeyili hagati ya mudasobwa zahujwe na ARPANET bwoherejwe na Ray Tomlinson mu 1971.

Igitangaje ni uko Tomlinson ubwe yaje kuvuga ko atibuka neza amagambo yari agize ubutumwa bwa mbere yohereje, kuko icyo gihe yari agamije kugerageza niba ubwo buryo bushoboka.

UKO @ YAJE GUKORESHWA KU MBUGA NKORANYAMBAGA

Uko murandasi yagiye itera imbere, ikimenyetso cya @ cyakomeje kubona akandi kazi gashya. Ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, cyane cyane Twitter, ubu yitwa X, cyaje gukoreshwa mu kwita cyangwa guhamagara umuntu ukoresheje izina rye kuri urwo rubuga.

Urugero, iyo umuntu yanditse @Janvier, ashobora kuba agamije kuvuga umuntu ufite iryo zina kuri urwo rubuga cyangwa kumumenyesha ko hari ubutumwa bumureba. Ibi byatumye @ iba ikimenyetso cy'ingenzi mu guhuza abantu, ibitekerezo n'ibiganiro byo kuri murandasi.

AMAZINA ATANDUKANYE @ YITWA MU BIHUGU BITANDUKANYE

Ikimenyetso cya @ ntikigira izina rimwe ku isi hose. Buri rurimi cyangwa igihugu kigira uburyo bwacyo bwo kukita, akenshi bushingiye ku ishusho yacyo.

Urugero: Mu Cyongereza cyitwa At Sign. Mu Gifaransa cyitwa Arobase, ariko hari n'abacyita Escargot, bisobanura ikinyamushongo. Mu Gitaliyani cyitwa Chiocciola, naho bisobanura ikinyamushongo. Mu kidage bamwe bakita Klammeraffe, bisobanura umurizo w'inguge. Mu Giholandi cyitwa Apestaart, nabyo bisobanura umurizo w'inguge.

Ibi bigaragaza uburyo iki kimenyetso gishobora kugira amazina atandukanye bitewe n'umuco n'ururimi rw'abagikoresha.

Iyi mibare ishingiye ku matora yabaye ku wa 24 Ugushyingo 2026, igaragaza ko abagore bamaze kugira uruhare rugaragara mu miyoborere y’Uturere. Icyakora, iyo harebwe imyanya batorewe, bigaragara ko bakiri bake mu bashinzwe ubukungu, ugereranyije n’abashinzwe imibereho myiza y’abaturage.

Mu myanya 27 y’Abayobozi b’Akarere Bungirije bashinzwe Imibereho Myiza y’Abaturage, abagore bafite 18, bangana na 66.7%. Mu bashinzwe Ubukungu, abagore ni batanu gusa kuri 27, bangana na 18.5%.

Mu Turere dutanu ari two Burera, Gicumbi, Nyamagabe, Nyaruguru na Ngororero, ni ho abagore batorewe kuba abayobozi bungirije bashinzwe Ubukungu. Mu tundi Turere 22, iyo myanya iri mu maboko y’abagabo.

Mu Ntara y’Iburasirazuba, abagore bose uko ari barindwi bashinzwe Imibereho Myiza y’Abaturage, ariko nta n’umwe ufite inshingano z’Ubukungu. Mu Majyaruguru ho, nta mugore watorewe kuyobora urwego rushinzwe Imibereho Myiza y’Abaturage, mu gihe babiri ari bo bashinzwe Ubukungu.

Mu myanya 27 y’Abayobozi b’Uturere, abagore batorewe kuyobora umunani, bangana na 29.6%, mu gihe abagabo ari 19.

Abo bagore bayobora Gakenke, Musanze na Rulindo mu Majyaruguru; Ngoma na Rwamagana mu Burasirazuba; Kamonyi na Ruhango mu Majyepfo; na Nyabihu mu Burengerazuba.

Uturere tune ari two Ngoma, Rwamagana, Kamonyi na Ruhango dusa n’utwihariye kuko abagore bafite imyanya ibiri muri Komite Nyobozi: uw’Umuyobozi w’Akarere n’uw’Umuyobozi w’Akarere Wungirije ushinzwe Imibereho Myiza y’Abaturage. Umwanya w’ushinzwe Ubukungu muri two ufitwe n’abagabo.

Iburasirazuba ni bwo bufite ijanisha ryo hejuru

Iyo harebwe uko abagore bagabanye imyanya mu Ntara, Iburasirazuba ni bwo buza imbere n’abagore icyenda kuri 21, bangana na 42.9%. Amajyepfo akurikiraho n’abagore 10 kuri 24 (41.7%), mu gihe Amajyaruguru afite batanu kuri 15 (33.3%), Iburengerazuba bukagira barindwi kuri 21 (33.3%).

Itegeko Nshinga rya Repubulika y’u Rwanda riteganya ko abagore bagira nibura 30% by’imyanya mu nzego zifatirwamo ibyemezo. Kuba bafite 38.3% muri Komite Nyobozi z’Uturere bivuze ko barenze icyo gipimo.

Icyakora, imibare y’aya matora igaragaza ko kuba abagore barenze igipimo cyagenwe bitavuze ko bafite uruhare rungana n’urw’abagabo mu myanya yose. Kuba bakiri bake mu bashinzwe Ubukungu, mu gihe biganje mu bashinzwe Imibereho Myiza y’Abaturage, bigaragaza ko hakiri ikibazo cy’uko abagore bagabana imyanya n’inshingano mu buyobozi bw’inzego z’ibanze.

MN202611_zfnabwxs8a.t:
Akarere ka Bugesera hamwe n’Umuryango w’Abagide mu Rwanda ku bufatanye n’Umuryango mpuzamahanga wa ‘Plan International Rwanda’, bari mu bukangurambaga bw’iminsi 16 (guhera ku itariki 25 Ugushyingo kugeza ku itariki 10 Ukuboza 2026)bugamije kurwanya ihohotera rishingiye ku gitsina rikorerwa abana.Ubukangurambaga burimo kubera mu Mirenge ya Kamabuye na Ngeruka yombi yo mu Karere ka Bugesera.

Ibikorwa by’ingenzi ubwo bukangurambaga bwibandaho, ni ukwigisha ibijyanye n’ubuzima bw’imyororokere,isuku ndetse no kurinda urubyiruko kugwa mu bishuko biganisha ku ihohotera. Binyuze muri ubwo bukangurambaga, ababyeyi bakangurirwa kuganiriza abana babo ku buzima bw’imyororokere nta pfunwe bafite, kugira ngo abana n’urubyiruko bagire amakuru ahagije kandi y’ukuri yabafasha kwirinda ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina.

Nk’uko byagarutsweho n’Umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’Umurenge wa Ngeruka Kadafi Aimable, mu rwego rwo kurinda abana guhohoterwa, ababyeyi bakwiye kuba inshuti z’abana babo,bakaganira bihagije, bakabaha amakuru ahagije yatuma bashobora kurinda ubuzima bwabo. Ikindi ngo kuba ubwo bukangurambaga bwabereye muri iyo Mirenge ya Ngeruka na Kamabuye, ntibivuze ko ari ho hari ibyaha byinshi bijyanye no guhohotera abana kurusha ahandi, ahubwo ni uko nubwo yaba umwana umwe cyangwa se babiri bahohotewe, ubuzima bwabo bw’ejo heza buba bwatangiye kwangirika.

Yagize ati,”Ingamba ya mbere ni uguca amakimbirane yo mu miryango, kuko ni ho hambere haturuka ihohotera.Nk’uko mwabyumvise, harimo n’abahohoterwa n’ababyeyi babo,ugasanga umugabo uhohoteye umwana, yari afitanye amakimbirane n’umugore we,hanyuma kuko atishimiye umugore we, akumva yajya gusambanya umwana yabyaye cyangwa se arera. Icyiza ni uko ubu bukangurambaga bwaba ikintu dufatanyijemo twese, ababyeyi, abana, abarezi, abayobozi ndetse n’abanyamakuru , tugafatanya kugira ngo ubwo butumwa bugere henshi hashoboka.Kumenya iri hohoterwa icyo ari cyo, ibihano bikakaye bijyana naryo, ndetse uhanwe kubera icyo cyaha, bikamenyakana, ko umuntu kanaka yakatiwe igihano cy’imyaka 25 kubera ko yahohoteye umwana runaka, icyo gihe ntekereza ko bishobora gufasha n’abandi kuba babyirinda…”.

Umutoniwase Shemsa wari uhagarariye Umuryango w’Abagide mu Rwanda muri ubwo bukangurambaga, yavuze ko uwo muryango usanzwe ufite inshingano zo kwigisha abana, abangavu n’urubyiruko kugira ngo babone amakuru ahagije ku buzima bw’imyororokere, bityo bamenye kwirinda ihohotera, bamenye kuvuga ‘oya’ ku babashuka n’ibindi bibi bahura nabyo.

Umutoniwase yasobanuye ko muri iyi minsi 16 y’ubukangurambaga,Umuryango w’Abagide ku Isi, ufite insanganyamatsiko yo gushishikariza abana b’abakobwa kumenya gukoresha imbuga nkoranyambaga mu buryo bwiza,bityo rero n’Abagide bo mu Rwanda, bakaba barimo gukora ubwo bukangurambaga bwo kurwanya ihohotera rishingiye ku gitsina,bakoresha n’imbuga nkoranyambaga batanga ubutumwa buboneye bwo gufata mu mugongo abamaze guhura n’ingaruka z’iryo hohoterwa,no gushishikariza Abanyarwanda muri rusange kurirwanya kandi buri munsi atari muri iyi minsi 16 gusa.

Yagize ati,” …Kwigisha ibijyanye n’ubuzima bw’imyororokere,ni ubumenyi bukenewe cyane ku babyeyi ndetse no ku bana.Murabizi ko hakiri icyuho kinini mu muco wacu, ababyeyi ntabwo bafunguka ngo bavuge. Ariko iyo waganirije umwana wawe, akaba afite amakuru ku buzima bw’imyororokere, azi ko ‘oya’ ari ‘oya’ na ‘yego’ ikaba ari ‘yego’.Akaba azi kuvuga ngo nta muntu wemerewe kunkoraho cyangwa se kunkoresha icyo ntashaka. Niyo mpamvu Umuryango w’Abagide uri muri iyi Mirenge kugira ngo dutange amakuru turwanye iryo hohotera, abana bacu bagire amakuru yizewe”.

MN202611_1ymvl3knii6.t:
Garnacho has not played for Aston Villa since making a three-minute cameo in a 1-1 draw against Fulham on 31 October.

Aston Villa boss Unai Emery has praised Alejandro Garnacho's "fantastic attitude" -but suggested other players rank ahead of him after the Argentine was left out of Tuesday's Champions League defeat at Galatasaray.

The 22-year-old winger joined Aston Villa on loan from Chelsea in the summer, but he has played just 34 minutes in the Premier League this season.

Garnacho was left at home for the 2-0 loss by Galatasaray , with Emery bringing 11 substitutes - including two goalkeepers - rather than the maximum 12.

"When he is not involved in the squad it is because I have to choose with other players as well," said the Villa boss on Friday.

"He has my respect first as a person and second as a player, but he is not involved for this reason.

"But football can change. We are playing matches so I will need players."

Not even making a 12-man bench - what next for Garnacho?

Garnacho has played in just four of Villa's 11 Premier League matches this season and has yet to start across all competitions, coming off the bench for all seven of his appearances.

His last appearance - just a three-minute cameo - came in the 1-1 draw against Fulham on 31 October.

"Alejandro Garnacho is training very well. His attitude is fantastic, very good attitude," Emery added.

"He was struggling at the beginning of the season because he was not fit. Now he is fit and he's training at a good level."

Sources have acknowledged Garnacho was not at the level required and were surprised how off the pace he was when he signed in July.

He initially trained on his own, while his problems were not helped by a head injury suffered in Thailand in pre-season.

"Of course now he, and other players as well, are performing well, they are working well, they understood how we are building the squad," Emery said.

"It's not how it was two months ago when he wasn't fit enough to be playing with the consistency we needed.

"So keep going, keep moving forward as a club, as a team, he himself as a player and we will see it."

Garnacho's move to Villa will become permanent for £43m at the end of the season should certain criteria be met, but there are concerns his time at the club could become similar to that of Harvey Elliot , who played just nine times last season after arriving on loan from Liverpool .

Fifa rules allow players to play for two clubs in a season - or three if they move to a team whose season overlaps like the Major League Soccer - meaning Garnacho could feature for another team, unlike Elliott as he had already played for Liverpool and Villa.

However, Emery said he was not thinking about the upcoming January transfer window as he added: "It is November, of course there is a transfer window in January, but we are not thinking about the transfer window in January. Me especially."

MN202611_1wt32y9vzf3.t:
Callum Scott Howells played Henry Paget in a film inspired by his life

A rare pair of pantomime programmes from the private theatre of a man dubbed "the Freddie Mercury of his time" have sold at auction for £3,600.

The 4th Marquess of Anglesey Henry Cyril Paget , also known as the Dancing Marquess, used his family home Plas Newydd, on Anglesey, to stage lavish productions free for local people.

His life was recently turned into a biopic, with Callum Scott Howells playing the aristocrat .

The programmes were for a production of Red Riding Hood and in the shapes of Little Red Riding Hood and Little Boy Blue.

Auctioneer Ben Rogers Jones said they were a "special piece of history" allowing people to look at text "Paget's audience held in their hands on Boxing Day 1902".

Rogers Jones added it was difficult to predict what "two bits of cardboard could make", but the backstory and film, nominated for six Bafta Cymru awards , helped with the sale.

"There is definitely hype around what is a very modern story," he said.

"He was a flamboyant character. A Freddie Mercury of his time."

Paget was declared bankrupt at the start of the 20th Century, and his 17,000 possessions were sold in a 40-day auction to pay his creditors.

He lived a life of excess before dying from tuberculosis aged 29 in 1905.

The programmes were made for a production of Red Riding Hood

The programmes came to auction from a family from Carreg Bran, Llanfairpwll, which is a short distance from Plas Newydd.

Card cloaks open to reveal the cast list, with the Marquess listed under his stage name Mr Alex Keith.

They were offered alongside a souvenir handkerchief from the 1912 wedding of Paget's cousin and heir, the 6th Marquess, whose marriage to Lady Marjorie Manners was seen as restoring the family's fortunes.

The programmes offer an evocative link between Paget and his performances, and it is thought they were even printed locally in Bangor, according to Rogers Jones.

The card cloaks open to reveal a cast list for Red Riding Hood

The unique shape of the programmes also offers something different, and he said it was "quite apt that no expense was spared" considering Paget's penchant for extravagance.

Rogers Jones said: "The condition was brilliant. They've been kept and preserved in remarkable condition."

The auctioneer believes the programmes had likely been kept hidden away by Paget's family as he was known as the embarrassing ancestor until time and changing attitudes have cast his exploits in a more understanding light.

"That's why these things make money. They're rare because people disregard them," he added.

Horse and Rider at Llanddwyn sold for £30,000

Also included in the auction were 50 works by the Welsh landscape painter Sir Kyffin Williams .

The combined estimate exceeded £250,000 and featured several works including Horse and Rider at Llanddwyn and a painting of two Welsh black bulls.

The sale also paid tribute to Kevin Sinnot , one of the defining figures in contemporary Welsh art, who died in July aged 78.

Ten pieces of his works were up for auction including the large oil painting Strangers and Don't Look Back.

MN202611_m3tqz7mng1.t:
Four million people in Lagos, Nigeria may be exposed to extreme sea levels by the end of the century, a new study says

Some of Africa's largest cities are sinking faster than previously thought, new research shows.

Scientists used radar imagery from the European Space Agency's Sentinel-1 satellites to map how much the land beneath 20 African coastal cities had moved.

The study found that some cities - including Lagos in Nigeria and Alexandria in Egypt - were sinking much faster than previously estimated in 2021 by the UN's climate body, the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC).

While some causes of this sinking, or subsidence, are natural, many are the result of human activities, such as the extraction of groundwater from underneath the Earth's surface.

Lead author Oluwaseyi Dasho said the effects of subsidence "are often invisible in everyday life, but over decades they can substantially increase flood exposure".

This is because when the ground sinks it becomes lower relative to the ocean and adds to the risk of the sea level rises caused by climate change .

Seven million people, one billion buildings and $180bn (£137bn) of assets could be at flood risk by 2050, the paper estimated.

In the past, a lack of monitoring stations has prevented scientists from obtaining up-to-date localised information on subsidence in Africa, Dasho said.

But by using satellite data, the researchers from Virginia Tech were able to detect land movements as small as 1mm per year.

Senior author Manoochehr Shirzaei said Sentinel-1 satellites flew over the same region of the Earth every six to 12 days.

"[The satellite] transmits the radar signal, which hits the ground and bounces back to the satellite," the geosciences professor explained. This process is then repeated on "many revisits".

The time between sending the signal and receiving it back is recorded, with changes in this value over time revealing how much the land has moved.

More of Alexandria could be exposed to flooding than previously thought, the research says

The ground under Alexandria and Lagos was found to have sunk an average of 6mm and 5mm per year respectively.

If this rate continued, sea levels around Alexandria would rise 36% more by 2050 than the IPCC predicted , external , under the middle estimates for how much planet-warming emissions will increase.

Luanda in Angola has also sunk significantly, but other cities such as Durban in South Africa have remained stable or even risen slightly.

Shirzaei said showing where the IPCC had underestimated risks - but also where the threat had been overestimated - could help planners allocate resources more effectively.

The man-made drivers of subsidence are usually "extremely local, [which] means that we can combat them by creating local policies", Shirzaei explained.

One major cause is the increased water consumption of rapidly growing cities. Too much water being extracted from the ground can lead to the soil becoming compacted and the surface sinking.

The Aswan Dam on the Nile may also be trapping sediment upstream and preventing the replacement of sinking land in Alexandria, the study suggests.

In Lagos, the reclaiming of land from the ocean to create artificial islands and the construction of buildings on loose ground are other possible causes of subsidence.

Hear from those trying to solve the problem

Methods of preventing cities from sinking include supplying other water sources and growing less water-intensive crops.

"Whatever we cannot mitigate, we try to adapt to it," Shirzaei added. This could mean building flood defences or moving key infrastructure to a higher level .

The professor said developing countries had been "left out" of much of the planning for sea-level rises due to a lack of monitoring.

The techniques developed in this study could potentially be used to address the knowledge gap in other regions, such as the Pacific islands, Shirzaei suggested.

Oluwaseyi Dasho said he hoped the paper, in Science Advances, , external could help African governments "prepare adequately for future challenges and more importantly for the future generations".

MN202611_tw35si7b5c.t:
Uyu mushinga witwa Edible Urban Forests Initiative (EUF), wateguwe na FAO binyuze muri gahunda yayo y’ubufatanye mu bya tekiniki (Technical Cooperation Programme – TCP/RWA/4103), ugamije guhindura ahantu hatakoreshwaga mu mijyi, hagaterwa ibiti by’imbuto bishobora gutanga umusaruro ufitiye abaturage akamaro.

Muri uyu mushinga, hateganyijwe guterwa ibiti by’imbuto bigera ku 55.000 byatewe mu buryo bwo kubangurira amashami (grafting), birimo imyembe, avoka n’amoko atandukanye y’amacunga n’indimu. Bizaterwa ahantu hatoranyijwe mu Mujyi wa Kigali no mu bice byegereye uyu mujyi.

Uretse kongera umusaruro w’imbuto zifasha mu mirire myiza, ibi biti biteganyijwe gufasha mu kongera ibinyabuzima bitandukanye mu mijyi, gusana ibice byangijwe n’ibikorwa bya muntu no kongera ubushobozi bw’imijyi bwo guhangana n’ingaruka z’imihindagurikire y’ibihe.

Uyu mushinga kandi uzafasha mu guhanga imirimo ijyanye no kurengera ibidukikije, guteza imbere ubufatanye bw’abaturage no gushyigikira iterambere rirambye ry’imijyi.

Ni gahunda ihuye n’intego z’ingenzi u Rwanda rwihaye mu iterambere, zirimo Icyerekezo 2050, Gahunda ya Kabiri y’Igihugu yo Kwihutisha Iterambere (NST2), Ingamba zo Kwihutisha Iterambere Rishingiye ku Bukungu Butabangamiye Ibidukikije no Guhangana n’Imihindagurikire y’Ibihe (GGCRS), ndetse n’izindi gahunda z’igihugu zirimo kurengera urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima no guteza imbere imijyi.

Umuhango wo gutangiza ku mugaragaro uyu mushinga no gutangira kuwushyira mu bikorwa uteganyijwe ku wa 28 Ugushyingo 2026, mu Murenge wa Masaka, mu Karere ka Kicukiro.

Uyu muhango uzitabirwa n’abayobozi bakuru muri Guverinoma, abayobozi ba FAO, inzobere mu bijyanye n’ibidukikije n’ubuhinzi, abafatanyabikorwa mu iterambere ndetse n’abaturage bo mu gace umushinga uzatangirizwamo.

Abazitabira bazafatanya mu gikorwa cyo gutera ibiti by’imbuto, mu rwego rwo kugaragaza uruhare rw’inzego zitandukanye n’abaturage mu kubungabunga ibidukikije no kubaka imijyi ifite ubushobozi bwo guhangana n’ingaruka z’imihindagurikire y’ibihe.

Iki gikorwa kizakorwa mu murongo wa gahunda ya Umuganda, hagaragazwa ko gutera ibiti by’imbuto mu mijyi atari uburyo bwo kongera ibiribwa gusa, ahubwo ari n'intambwe igana ku mijyi itoshye, ifite ubuzima bwiza kandi irambye.

MN202611_136763wrcwa.t: Ni umukino ‎ wabereye kuri Kigali Pele Stadium kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki ya 27 Ugushyingo 2026, Ni umukino watangiranye imbaraga ku ikipe ya Rayon Sports ubona isatira cyane ikipe ya Kiyovu Sports ariko ubwugarizi bw'iyi kipe bwa Mbonyingabo Regis na Rwabuhihi Aime Placide n'umunyezamu James Desire bugakiza izamu. ‎ ‎Ku munota wa karindwi w’umukino, Gikundiro yafunguye amazamu ku gitego cyatsizwe na Muderi Akbari, ku mupira wazamuwe na Muhoza Daniel wakinaga ku ruhande rw'iburyo imbere maze awuhindura imbere y'izamu rya James Desire, Muderi ahita awutera mu rushundura. ‎ ‎Nyuma yo gutsindwa igitego Urucaca rwakangutse rutangira gukina neza cyane cyane mu kibuga hagati kuri Uwimana Yakubu, Nsanzimfura Keddy na Charif Bayo ariko kugera imbere y'izamu rya Dande Junior biba ikibazo kubera ko ubwugarizi Mohamed Ouattara na Nshuti Didier buhagarara neza. Igice cya mbere kirangira ari 1-0. ‎ ‎Rayon Sports yinjiye mu gice cya kabiri ikina neza ariko Kiyovu Sports ihita ikanguka ikomeza kwataka yifashije impande zayo zari ziriho Richard Kirongozi na Shabani Kagayo. Umutoza Muvunyi Flex yakoze impinduka akuramo Uwimana Yakubu azana mu Kibuga Bukuru Christophe maze ayobora umukino karahava. ‎ ‎Abatoza ku mpande zombi bagiye bakora impinduka zitandukanye ariko umukino urangira Rayon Sports ibonye amanota atatu y'ingenzi bituma ifata umwanya wa kane n'amanota 15 naho Kiyovu sports igera lu mwanya wa katindwi n'amanota 13. ‎

MN202611_1omduyjcaw.t:
Pedro Sánchez accused his opponents of hurling insults and lies but his conservative rival has promised a new era of politics

Spain's main party leaders have held their final rallies ahead of Sunday's election, with Socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez saying he is confident of defying the polls.

"I cannot imagine us losing," he said, posing for selfies with supporters in red T-shirts and accusing conservative rival Alberto Núñez Feijóo of planning a coalition with the far right.

Feijóo's People's Party (PP) is narrowly ahead in the polls, and in the final hours of the campaign he travelled first to Barcelona and then Seville, promising voters a new political era of "truth, decency and good governance".

He accused Sánchez of evading questions on key issues like corruption, rail disasters, immigration and the national debt.

The Socialist leader heads one of Europe's few left-wing governments, and with the French presidential elections five months away, there is a real chance that two of the continent's biggest economies could move to the right in quick succession.

Almost 39 million people have a vote in Spain and while commentators expect a high turnout, most polls have suggested a close finish. Under Spanish electoral law, no polls have been published since Monday.

"This time, yes, we're going to do it," Feijóo told PP supporters, in a nod to his failure to form a government three years ago despite winning most seats.

Alberto Núñez Feijóo's PP holds a narrow lead in the opinion polls

If he gets to form a government this time, it will be with the support of anti-immigration party Vox, led by Santiago Abascal, whose final rally took place in a bull-ring in Valencia on Spain's east coast.

Pedro Sánchez's government "has betrayed us, he has robbed us and he has lied to us", Abascal told an audience earlier in Tarancón, to the south-east of Madrid.

Vox is hoping to almost double its seats from the 33 it won three years ago. It backs policies such as "national priority" - putting Spanish citizens first for welfare - and "remigration" for foreigners not considered to be contributing to the economy.

Leaders clash in final Spain election debate as housing dominates run-in

Spanish election: What you need to know and what's at stake

Clashing political visions reflect a divided Spain ahead of election

The final day of campaigning was very much in the shadow of a four-way TV debate the night before that exposed Spain's sharply polarised politics.

All four leaders had solutions for the housing crisis. Feijóo said the PP would build a million homes over four years, while Sánchez said housing should be a right not an object of speculation and profit.

Watch: Could housing decide Spain's general election?

While the conservatives tried to turn the spotlight on the series of scandals that have overshadowed the Socialists' term in office, Sánchez and his left-wing ally Ada Colau, who heads Frente Amplio (The Broad Front), focused on women's rights.

The two leaders seized on a moment in the debate when the PP leader accused Colau and the rest of the left of staying quiet during a flood disaster in Valencia, briefly moving his finger to his lips. The word he used "calladita" is a diminutive and can also be used to tell a woman to "keep quiet" in a condescending manner.

Sánchez reacted immediately and called on him to show "a little respect", accusing him of sexism.

Feijóo sought to clarify what he meant on Friday, and accused Ada Colau of remaining silent during "these years of corruption". His decision to wind up his campaign in Seville was significant, because the wider southern region of Andalusia has 61 seats in Spain's 350-seat parliament, more than any other.

Andalusia is also important because it is run by a coalition made up of the PP and Abascal's Vox, as are three other regions, Extremadura, Aragón, and Castilla y León.

Feijóo has insisted he wants to govern with a majority, backed up by "parliamentary support agreements" with Vox and says he has never spoken to Abascal about giving Vox ministerial power.

Sánchez took to the stage in Madrid with his wife Begoña Gómez, and donned a red T-shirt that read "power of the people".

He then went on to praise Colau and her left-wing coalition's campaign. As he was speaking, Colau told a large audience in the south of Madrid that not only would they "not remain silent, we will win", vowing to form another "progressive government".

MN202611_14t9rt12o9v.t:
The former Wales captain says he wants to encourage more men to talk openly about hair loss.

Rugby legend Alun Wyn Jones has urged men to open up about hair loss, saying he was "very comfortable" talking about the fact he has had a hair transplant.

Speaking one year since his operation, the former Wales and British and Irish Lions captain said men typically do not talk about the issue, but said "a lot of people" had spoken to him about it.

"I think it's important that people know there's a lot of people out there they can talk to," he said.

Jones played 158 times for Wales and 12 for the Lions, making him the most capped rugby player in history before he retired in 2023.

Jones, 41, from Swansea, said he "wasn't conscious" about his hair loss until his playing days were coming to an end.

He spent most of his career playing for the Ospreys, before a stint for Toulon in France near the end of his career.

He said his playing career had prevented him from getting a transplant sooner because of the time off required after the procedure and then to "recover properly".

But after his retirement he said he began to learn more about it and had the operation.

He said he hoped his openness about hair loss would encourage other men to talk about the issue.

"Men in general don't talk, but I've had a lot of people talk to me about it," he said.

Male pattern baldness , external (androgenetic alopecia) is a genetic form of hair loss, with signs of recession usually beginning in the teenage years with "prevalence and severity" increasing with age, according to the National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) , external .

It said that, in general 30% of white men are affected by 30, 50% by 50, and 80% by 70. Prevalence is highest in Caucasians.

Jones says he did not have the time for the procedure during his playing career

Since retiring from rugby, Jones has become an ambassador of 3rd Battalion, the Royal Welsh , the Army's only reserve infantry regiment in Wales, and has documented his efforts to learn Welsh.

Jones, whose wife and three daughters all speak Welsh at home, said learning the language was about "knowing my roots and belonging to my country".

He also competed in the 20th series of Celebrity MasterChef and finished as a runner-up.

In August he returned to the Ospreys as a director .

MN202611_2q4dbuf108.t:
Iri serukiramuco rimaze imyaka 12 riba, ryatangijwe hagamijwe guteza imbere abahanzi bo mu Rwanda, cyane cyane abakora filimi, no kongera agaciro ka sinema nyarwanda.

Iyarwema Simon, ushinzwe ibikorwa muri Mashariki African Film Festival, Mashariki Arts Academy na Mashariki Content Market, avuga ko iri serukiramuco ryashyizweho kugira ngo rihe abakora filimi nyarwanda urubuga rwo kugaragaza impano zabo no kugira uruhare mu guteza imbere urwego rw'ubuhanzi n'ibihangano mu gihugu.

Simon agira ati: "Mashariki Film Festival yashyiriweho abahanzi bose bo mu Rwanda, cyane cyane abakora filimi. Intego yayo ni ukuzamura filimi nyarwanda no kongera agaciro ka sinema mu Rwanda no muri Afurika."

Mashariki African Film Festival y'uyu mwaka, iri kubera i Kigali kuva ku wa 23 kugeza ku wa 29 Ugushyingo 2026, ifite insanganyamatsiko igira iti "Reels of Resilience", igamije kugaragaza akamaro ko kwihangana no kudacika intege mu guhangana n'ibibazo no kugera ku iterambere.

Simon avuga ko iyi nsanganyamatsiko igaragaza ko ukwihangana ari ingenzi mu iterambere ry'umuntu ku giti cye ndetse n'iry'abaturage muri rusange.

Yagize ati: "Kugira ngo ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose gitere imbere, umuntu agomba kugira ukwihangana. Twahisemo insanganyamatsiko ya 'Reels of Resilience' kugira ngo duhuze ukwihangana kwa buri muntu n'ibibazo anyuramo kugira ngo abashe kubitsinda no gukomeza gutera imbere."

Iri serukiramuco ryitabiriwe n'abakora filimi n'abandi banyamwuga baturutse mu bihugu bitandukanye birimo Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Afurika y'Epfo, Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, u Butaliyani, Finland n'u Budage.

Uretse kwerekana filimi, abayitegura banakoresha iri serukiramuco nk'urubuga rwo guhuza abanyamwuga, kungurana ubumenyi no gushaka abafatanyabikorwa binyuze muri Mashariki Content Market izwi nka MashaRket.

Iki gikorwa gihuza abakora filimi n'abandi bakora mu bijyanye n'amashusho n'itangazamakuru kugira ngo berekane ibikorwa byabo, bungurane ubunararibonye ku byiciro bitandukanye byo gukora filimi, guhera ku kwandika inkuru, kuyitunganya, kuyifatira amashusho kugeza ku kuyigeza ku bayireba.

Simon avuga ko iyi gahunda igamije gufasha abakora filimi kwigira kuri bagenzi babo no kubahuza n'abashobora kubafasha guteza imbere ibikorwa byabo.

Yagize ati: "Abantu dutumira bahurira hamwe bakerekana ibikorwa byabo. Bagaragaza uko bandika filimi, uko bazikora, uko bazitunganya n'uko zigerwaho n'abazireba. Ni amahirwe yo gufasha abantu bakora muri uru rwego kungurana ubumenyi."

Iri serukiramuco ryibanda ku iterambere ry'uruganda rwa sinema mu gihe u Rwanda rukomeje gushaka uko rwamenyekanisha filimi zarwo no kongera amahirwe yo guhangana ku rwego mpuzamahanga.

Simon avuga ko yishimira intambwe imaze guterwa n'abakora filimi nyarwanda ndetse n'abakinnyi, agaragaza ko kumenyekana kw'ibikorwa bimwe na bimwe ari ikimenyetso cy'ubushobozi bw'abanyarwanda muri uru rwego.

Yatanze urugero rwa filimi yitwa Ben’Imana, ihagarariye u Rwanda mu bihembo bya Oscars, avuga ko igaragaza ubushobozi n'ubuhanga abakora filimi mu Rwanda bafite.

Yagize ati: "Iyo tubonye filimi nka 'Ben’Imana' imenyekana, bigaragaza ko abakora filimi mu Rwanda bageze ku rwego rushimishije. Bigaragaza ko dufite ubushobozi bwo gukora filimi zishobora kumenyekana no guhabwa agaciro."

Gusa avuga ko hakenewe ubufasha buhoraho kugira ngo iri terambere rikomeze, cyane cyane uruhare rwa Leta n'ubwitange bw'abantu bakora muri uru rwego. Simon avuga ko ubufasha bwa Leta bwagize uruhare mu gufasha iri serukiramuco guhuza abantu n'abanyamwuga baturutse mu bihugu bitandukanye.

Yagize ati: "Turashimira ubufasha duhabwa na Leta. Butuma tubasha guhuza abantu baturutse mu bihugu bitandukanye. Iyo tutabona ubwo bufasha, byatugora kugera ku byo tumaze kugeraho."

Yasabye kandi Abanyarwanda bakora mu bijyanye no gutunganya filimi, gukina, ikinamico n'ibindi bikorwa bijyanye n'ubuhanzi gukomeza gushyira imbaraga mu guteza imbere impano zabo no gukora ibihangano bishobora kumenyekanisha igihugu ku rwego mpuzamahanga.

Mu gihe iri serukiramuco rikomeje gutegura ibikorwa by'ahazaza, intego yaryo ntigarukira gusa ku gutegura ibirori ngarukamwaka byerekanirwamo filimi.

Simon avuga ko Mashariki yifuza ko u Rwanda rwaba igihugu kizwi kandi gihatanira kwakira ibikorwa byo gukoreramo filimi muri Afurika, rukaba rwahangana n'ibihugu nka Kenya na Afurika y'Epfo bimaze kumenyekana muri uru rwego.

Yagize ati: "Icyerekezo dufite ni uko u Rwanda rwaba igihugu gikorerwamo filimi ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Turashaka guhangana n'ibihugu nka Kenya na Afurika y'Epfo bimaze kumenyekana muri uru rwego. Natwe turifuza ko u Rwanda rwagera kuri urwo rwego."

MN202611_lip9ms2iw2.t:
Abarwayi ba Diyabete n'ababana na Virusi itera Sida barasaba ko hashyirwa imbaraga mu kubongerera ubumenyi n'ubushobozi bwo kwiyitaho, kuko kubura amakuru ahagije ku buryo bwo guhangana n'indwara zabo bishobora gutuma ubuzima bwabo burushaho kujya mu kaga.

Basanga kugira ubumenyi ku ndwara babana na zo, bakamenya uko bazigenzura no gufata ingamba zibafasha gukomeza kwita ku buzima bwabo ari ingenzi mu kwirinda ingaruka zishobora guterwa no kutifata neza, cyane ko bahura n’abaganga gace cyane kuko mu minsi irenga 365 igize umwaka babonana na muganga inshuro 12 ni ukuvuga rimwe gusa mu kwezi.

Icyifuzo cyabo gishingiye ku kuba indwara nka diyabete na Virusi itera Sida zisaba abazirwaye kugira uruhare rugaragara mu kwita ku buzima bwabo, aho kutegereza gusa serivisi bahabwa kwa muganga, ahubwo bakamenya n'ibyo bakora buri munsi kugira ngo bagabanye ibyago byo kurushaho kuremba.

Ni bimwe mubyo bagarutseho kuri uyu wa 27 Ugushyingo 2026, mu nama nyunguranabitekerezo yaganiraga ku buryo bwo guteza imbere serivisi z’ubuvuzi zihuriweho zigenewe urubyiruko no gushyigikira ubuvugizi n’ubufatanye mu kuzitanga.

Yateguwe n’Ishyirahamwe ryita ku barwayi ba Diyabete (Rwanda Diabetes Association – RDA)) ku bufatanye n’Urugaga Nyarwanda rw’Abafite Virusi itera SIDA (RRP+), hagamijwe gushyira mu bikorwa umushinga ugamije kongerera ubushobozi abana, ingimbi n’abangavu ndetse n’urubyiruko rubana n’indwara ya diyabete ya mbere (Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus – T1DM), binyuze mu kubafasha kwiyitaho no kubaha ubufasha mu by’imitekerereze n’imibanire n’abandi mu Rwanda.

Hagaragajwe ko abarwayi n’abafite ubwandu bw’agakoko gatera Sida, by’umwihariko urubyiruko ruri hagati y’imyaka 10-24, bugarijwe n’ibibazo bikomeye birimo bituma batabana neza n’izo ndwara, birimo kutagira ubumenyi buhagije kuri zo, kuba serivisi bahabwa ziba zitatanya ku buryo hari abahitamo kwitabira bimwe ibindi bakabyihorera, guhezwa no guhabwa akato, kutagirirwa ibanga, bigatuma barushaho kuzahazwa n’izo ndwara ku buryo hari n’abakurizamo izindi zijyanye n’ubuzima bwo mu mutwe.

Bamwe mu barwayi ba Diyabete, bavuga ko kutagira ubumenyi buhagije ku buryo bashobora kwiyitaho ari kimwe mu bibazo bishobora gutuma barushaho kuremba, cyane ko ibyo banasabwa mu buryo bwo kwiyitaho, atari buri wese wabyishoboza, ntaho avomye ubumenyi kandi basabwa kubikora buri munsi inshuro zirenze imwe.

Uwo twise Ntakirutimana muri iyi nkuru, ni urubyiruko ruri mu kigero cy’imyaka 23 umaze imyaka 10 arwaye diyabete. Avuga ko bikwiye kandi ari ingenzi ko ubana n’indwara ya Diyabete bumufasha kwiyitaho.

Yagize ati “Impamvu ni uko ajya kuri randevu rimwe mu kwezi, indi minsi isigaye akimenya, akiyitaho, akamenya igihe afatira umuti bamuhaye, ingano yawo, ararya ate, arabihuza ate n’ubuzima bwa buri munsi azabamo muri iyo minsi. Ubwo bumenyi bufatiye aho, kuko iyo ubufite buragufasha, kuko wa munsi umwe uhura na muganga, ujyayo ugasanga ibipimo bimeze neza, ariko utabufite ajyayo agasanga bimeze nabi, ndetse bikaba byakuviramo impamvu yo kuba wagira izindi ndwara zituruka ku kuba isukari yawe itari ku murongo.”

Icyo gihe no umuntu ashobora kugira ingaruka zirimo gutakaza ubushobozi bwo kureba, kuba bamuca urugingo, kurwara ibisebe bidakira bitewe n’uko ubwirinzi bw’umubiri buba bwagabanutse n’ibindi bishobora gutuma yananiwe kubyihanganira bikaba byamuviramo kugira ibibazo bifitanye isano n’ubuzima bwo mu mutwe bivuye ku ihungabana ashobora gukurizamo.

Mugenzi we umaranye diyabete imyaka 5, avuga ko kimwe mu bibazo yahuye nabyo akimara kumenya ko arwaye, ni uguhabwa akato, kuko byamuviriyemo kwirukanwa ku kazi.

Ati “Nafashwe na Diyabete ndi mu kazi, nyuma umukoresha wanjye amaze kubimenya, ambwira ko nta komeza gukorana na we, urumva ko natakaje akazi kubera diyabete. Nari mfite fiyance (fiancé) na we amaze kumenya ko mfite diyabete, kubera ya magambo bavuga ngo umuntu urwaye diyabete ntashobora kubyara, na we yaransize. Icyo ni ikibazo gishobora gutuma ugira bya bibazo byo mu mutwe. Ni ngombwa ko umuntu ahabwa ubumenyi bwamufasha kwiyitaho, kuko uba ugomba kumenya uko ufata umuti, ntiwamenya umuti ufata utazi isukari ufite kuko ibipimo uba ufite ari byo biguha umuti uri bwitere.”

Ishyirahamwe ryita ku barwayi ba Diyabete rivuga ko kugira ngo ubuzima bw’abarwaye diyabe na virusi itera Sida ndetse bakaba baranakorewe ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina cyangwa bakagira ibyago bakaba baratwaye inda zitateguwe, bakwiye kugira serivisi ikomatanya ibyo byose kugira ngo bahave baziboneye rimwe, kuko kutazibonera hamwe bituma hari ibyo bitaho n’ibyo birengagiza.

Umuhuzabikorwa w’Ishyirahamwe ryita ku barwayi ba Biyabete, Etienne Uwingabire, avuga ko ikindi cy’ingenzi cyangwa cya ngombwa kuri abo barwayi ari uko bagomba kugira ubumenyi bwo kwiyitaho kugira ngo bibafashe gukurikirana ubuzima bwabo.

Ati “Abatabufite ni ba bandi bahora kwa muganga, bahora mu bitaro, ejo aragiye baramusezereye, ntiyubahirije gahunda, ntabwo yiyitayeho. Ariko tugashyiraho n’ikindi kijyanye n’uruhare rw’umuryango, ku buryo atabyigishwa wenyine ahubwo azana n’abo mu muryango, kugira ngo batagira ngo hari amategeko mashya azanye mu rugo, ahubwo na bo bakagira uruhare rwo gutuma uwo murwayi yiyitaho neza.”

Umukozi mu kigo cy’Igihugu cy’Ubuzima mu ishami ry’indwara zitandura, Jean Claude Habineza, avuga ko kugira ubumenyi bw’ibanze kuri izi ndwara bidasaba kuba umuntu yarize amashuri menshi.

Ati “Ubumenyi bw’ibanze kuri izi ndwara bufasha umuntu kubana na zo, n’umuntu udashobora gusoma ariko hari umuntu babana ushobora kumufasha gusoma ibipimo yagize, hanyuma kubera ubumenyi bamuhaye kwa muganga akaba yashobora kubikurikiza, cyangwa igihe adashobora kubikurikiza akazana kwa muganga n’umuntu babana, agahabwa ubwo bumenyi kugira ngo azashobore kumufasha kuko aba ari we baba bari kumwe cyane kurusha muganga.”

Raporo y’Ubushakashatsi ku Buzima n’Imibereho y’Abaturage mu Rwanda (RDHS 2025) igaragaza ko abantu bafite imyaka 15–49 bafite virusi itera SIDA bangana na 2,2%, mu gihe mu rubyiruko rufite imyaka 15–24, ubwandu bwa virusi itera SIDA buri kuri 0,8%.

Imibare y’Ishyirahamwe Mpuzamahanga ryita kuri Diyabete (IDF) yo mu 2024, igaragaza ko mu Rwanda abantu bakuru bafite imyaka iri hagati ya 20-79 bafite Diyabete bangana na 130.800 kandi 85,6% muri bo bakaba bataramenya ko bayirwaye.

Iyi mibare ntivuguruzanya byanze bikunze kuko iya RBC ireba abaturage bose, mu gihe iya IDF ireba abantu bakuru bafite imyaka 20–79 kandi ikoresha uburyo bwihariye bwo kugereranya imibare, mu gihe ku rubyiruko, cyane cyane abana, ingimbi n’abangavu, iyo mibare igaragaza ko abafite iyo mu bwoko bwa mbere (Type 1) bangana na 1.013.
